data.gender_notes: Prosen is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prosen is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Prosena', which means 'to approach, to invite'. It is a name that symbolizes wisdom and intelligence. Prosen is a name that is often given to a child who is believed to have a bright future ahead of him. The name Prosen carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Bengali. Parents who choose Prosen usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prosen is a name that holds significant spiritual meaning in Hinduism. It is believed that the name Prosen is associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. Prosen is a name that is believed to bring blessings of knowledge, intelligence, and wisdom to the child.
data.etymology: Prosen belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”

By naming a child Prosen, parents are manifesting the hope and the belief that their child will bring wisdom, knowledge, and positivity into their lives and the lives of those around them.
